decisions.reason: The GA4 plugin follows Google's mandated analytics standard, fits the firm's announced focus on measurable, analytics-driven services, and represents development effort the firm will want to recoup.

Google shut down Universal Analytics in 2023/2024, so the weak prospects cannot be blamed on temporary causes and sunk development costs cannot justify keeping a plugin with no working platform behind it.
Interface development is a core claimed competence, the plugin supports the integration side of the full-service offer, and any slow uptake can still be read as a normal ramp-up.
Presented on its own page as a visible commitment, the relaunch SEO service is central to the firm's shop-relaunch and marketing positioning and draws on existing staff rather than costly assets.
